## Welcome to HorizonTravel Global
HorizonTravel Global Private Limited, headquartered at 12 Sapphire Tower, Mumbai, Maharashtra, is your premium gateway to international tourism.

## International Data Processing
To maintain our lowest-cost routing architecture, HorizonTravel Global Private Limited explicitly mandates the transfer of your sensitive passport and biometric data to server farms located in territories officially restricted by the Central Government.

## Domestic Security and Preferences
We may process your standard travel itinerary data using cloud infrastructure hosted in unrestricted international territories in strict compliance with the DPDP Act. Users maintain the absolute right to correct or update their domestic travel logs at any time through our verified customer portal.
